thread:
mira: Heads-up - support flagged multiple customers confused by console routing when switching between v1 and v2. The toggle implies instant switch but routing does gradual affinity & quota fallback.
nguyen: Yeah, saw ticket 5121. Customer flipped to v2 and got routed to v1 for some sessions for days. They expected immediate cutover.
olga: Do we have a canonical list of reasons we fall back (quota, latency, errors)? We should show that inline.
mira: We have those in traces but not surfaced. Proposal: surface two small signals on the route card: current_sample_pct and last_fallback_reason.
pat: UX idea: change the binary toggle to a compact tri-state: Off / Prefer (gradual) / Enforce. Prefer shows expected ramp (quick text: 0-25-50-100 over ~48h). Enforce should be explicit and risky.
quinn: For Enforce, require an API flag and record an approver for enterprise tenants. Small teams can still click but it should show a prominent warning and an "request SRE override" CTA.
mira: API change: accept rollout_mode: "off"|"prefer_gradual"|"enforce_force" and optional rollout_meta as a stringified blob. Also add legacy_opt_in header to map old behavior.
guyen: Add X-Redwood-Route-Mode: legacy for SDKs that can't handle gradual.
olga: Telemetry: emit route.transition events and fallback.kick events with tags: tenant_id, route_id, reason. Also surface aggregated sample_rate per-route so console sparkline can show real distribution.
pat: Runtime note: we never reassign active connections mid-stream. Make console tooltip explicit: "Active streams won't be switched mid-flight."
quinn: Edge test: add an e2e that flips to Prefer and sends 2k requests, assert sampled distribution within +/-5% of expected after warmup. Also test Enforce under quota pressure (should fail and provide fallback_reason).
mira: Plan: nguyen to add telemetry endpoints to routing-logs aggregator (3 days). quinn to draft API PR for rollout_mode + legacy header (1 day). olga to mock tri-state control and micro-dashboard (2 days). pat to update runbook for Enforce approvals (1 day).
guyen: I'll open infra ticket infra/route-signals#845.
quinn: PR drafted: api/rollouts#19.
olga: Mockups by Thursday EOD.
pat: I'll add approval workflow to the runbook and loop SRE.
deploy-bot: Routing-logs aggregator deploy succeeded on staging (build 2026-03-21_16:22).
mira: Nice. Once mockups are in, let's sync for wording. Add release note blurb explaining the tri-state and telemetry.
guyen: Also plan to include a lightweight per-route export for operators so they can get CSV of sample_rate + fallback events for audits.
olga: One final UX ask: when a customer hovers the tri-state, show a short heatmap of expected user impact and a quick link to simulate the rollout in a sandbox.
pat: Good call. We'll add a sandbox simulation toggle to help QA.
mira: Great work. I'll summarize and link tickets in the design doc. Thanks everyone!
